headline: Trump Demands U.N. Hold China to Account for Coronavirus Pandemic
snippet: In speeches broadcast at this year’s General Assembly, the presidents of China and the U.S. punctuated an intensifying schism between the two nations.

headline: U.N. General Assembly: China Calls on World to Reject Politicization of Covid
snippet: President Trump blamed “the China virus” for global catastrophe, and Xi Jinping of China claimed the mantle of environmental champion. Follow updates here.

headline: IPhone 6s’s Hands-Free Siri Is an Omen of the Future
snippet: Voice recognition and artificial intelligence have improved so fast that we are nearing “ambient computing,” or robotic assistants that are always on hand.

headline: The N.F.L. Extra Point Has Changed, but Deuces Still Aren’t Wild
snippet: The numbers show that coaches ought to try for 2 points, and ought to do so by rushing. Instead, they’re doing what they usually do, playing it safe.

headline: Rocket Fuel Lifts Off With $10 Million From Nokia
